text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and eighty-seven is hereby amended to read
"Section 1. The sale in the Mountain Province, except in the City of Baguio, and in the Province of Nueva
Vizcaya, except in the municipalities of Aritao, Bagabag, Bambang, Bayombong, Dupax, and Solano, and in
the Province of Agusan, except in the municipalities of Butuan, Cabadbaran, Talacogon, Jabonga, and Nasipit,
of any ardent spirits, ale, beer, wine, or intoxicating liquors of any kind other than the so-called native wines
and liquors which members of non-Christian tribes have been accustomed themselves to make, prior to the
passage of this Act, is hereby prohibited and declared to be unlawful."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 9, 1931.
